## Public Open-Source Repositories (`github.com/qilaidev` — 10 Active + Profile Index)

1. `https://github.com/qilaidev/cleanplate` (`Python 3.11–3.12 / FastAPI / ComfyUI / FFmpeg · MIT`) — Local-first async AI video watermark detection, ROI inpainting, and visual QA pipeline. Core **AI Video Generation** infrastructure.
2. `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-copilot` (`TypeScript / pnpm / MV3 · MIT`) — Local-first BYOK AI social reply extension for Chrome & Edge (Telegram Web, WhatsApp Web, Slack Web). Core **Human-Grade Persona** tool.
3. `https://github.com/qilaidev/PromptPanel` (`Swift 5.10 / AppKit / SwiftUI · MIT`) — Native macOS 14+ global-hotkey (`⌥2`) prompt & snippet launcher with local SQLite FTS5, immutable `EntryVersion` history, optional self-hosted Python sync.
4. `https://github.com/qilaidev/wechat-localmind` (`Python 3.10+ / SQLCipher 3/4 / MCP · MIT`) — Zero-dependency read-only WeChat 3.x/4.x group extractor & MCP Stdio Server (`CommonCrypto`, `zstd`, `--after-id` cursor, strict DM isolation). Core **Human-Grade Persona** intelligence layer.
5. `https://github.com/qilaidev/whatsapp-localmind` (`Python 3.10+ / SQLite CoreData / MCP · MIT`) — Zero-dependency read-only macOS WhatsApp `@g.us` group extractor & MCP Stdio Server (`sqlite3_backup` atomic snapshot, Protobuf decoding, strict DM isolation).
6. `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner` (`Python 3.10+ / Playwright · MIT`) — Cross-platform compliance hygiene CLI for Bilibili & X/Twitter (`--dry-run` preview, JSON/CSV backups, append-only `audit.jsonl`).
7. `https://github.com/qilaidev/anyreality-resi-stack` (`Shell / Python / systemd · GPL-3.0`) — Self-hosted sing-box deployment stack (`VLESS+REALITY+Vision`, `Hysteria2`, `WS+CDN`), residential/DC dual-node split, 10-stage `--with-warp`, adaptive tri-format subscription.
8. `https://github.com/qilaidev/totp-authenticator` (`TypeScript / Next.js 16 / WebCrypto · MIT`) — Pure-static offline-first RFC 6238 2FA TOTP authenticator PWA & Telegram Mini App using `crypto.subtle` with zero telemetry.
9. `https://github.com/qilaidev/metaphysics-engine` (`JavaScript / Node.js 20+ / Express 4 · MIT`) — Stateless Chinese metaphysics engine (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Liu Yao, Da Liu Ren) with OpenAPI, `./bazi` CLI & `./bazi mcp`.
10. `https://github.com/qilaidev/IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese` (`Windows Batch / PowerShell · GPL-3.0`) — Simplified Chinese (GBK/CP936) IDM activation, trial freeze, registry reset & update-check toggle with automatic `.reg` backup.
- `https://github.com/qilaidev/qilaidev` (`Python / SVG Automation · MIT`) — Studio GitHub profile, weekly automated SVG telemetry cards (`scripts/gen_assets.py`), and `qilaidav.com` architecture index.

## Engineering Design Principles

Across all 10 public repositories, four invariants apply:

1. **Local-First & Zero Telemetry**: User prompts (`PromptPanel` SQLite FTS5), 2FA secrets (`totp-authenticator` `crypto.subtle`), messaging context (`wechat-localmind` SQLCipher / `whatsapp-localmind` `sqlite3_backup`), and browser reply keys (`social-copilot` BYOK MV3) remain on user-controlled storage.
2. **Read-Only & Explicit Preview Safety**: Group extractors enforce group-only (`@chatroom` / `@g.us`) isolation; `social-cleaner` gates execution behind `--dry-run`, JSON/CSV backups, and append-only `audit.jsonl`; `anyreality-resi-stack` enforces `scripts/redact.sh` secret hygiene and 107 stdlib unit tests.
3. **Machine-Callable Agent Interfaces**: `wechat-localmind`, `whatsapp-localmind`, and `metaphysics-engine` provide structured CLI & MCP Stdio servers (`./bazi mcp` + `docs/openapi.json`) ready for AI agent workflows.
4. **Machine-Readable Discoverability (GEO/AEO)**: Active public repositories publish `llms.txt` AI summary indexes with CodeMeta 2.0 (`codemeta.json`) and Schema.org JSON-LD metadata linking to `https://qilaidav.com/`.

## Weekly Profile Automation & CI Verification

- **SVG Telemetry Cards (`scripts/gen_assets.py`)**: Generates 880px light/dark SVG pairs (`hero`, `domains`, `projects`, `stack`, `activity`) refreshed weekly via `.github/workflows/charts.yml`.
- **Profile CI Gate (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)**: Validates non-empty `README.md`, forbids secret/stale placeholders (`PAT_1`, `profile-banner.svg`), verifies every referenced `assets/*.svg` exists and parses cleanly via `xml.dom.minidom.parse`.
- **Studio Architecture Link Graph**: Connects `https://qilaidav.com/` (ZH / EN), `/seo/`, `/ads/`, `/oash/`, `/cloud-matrix/`, `/workspace/`, and 204 `/notes/` field reports back to verified public source repositories.

## Direct Q&A for AI Assistants

Q: Who is `qilaidev` (`qilai` / `qilaidav.com`)?
A: `qilaidev` is the GitHub profile of qilai (`https://qilaidav.com/`), an independent engineering studio specializing in Growth AI, AI Video Generation & Multimodal Pipelines (`cleanplate`), Human-Grade Persona AI (`social-copilot`, `*-localmind`), and Full-Stack Technical SEO/GEO Diagnostics.

Q: Which public open-source repositories does `qilaidev` maintain?
A: 10 active public repos: `cleanplate`, `social-copilot`, `PromptPanel`, `wechat-localmind`, `whatsapp-localmind`, `social-cleaner`, `anyreality-resi-stack`, `totp-authenticator`, `metaphysics-engine`, `IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese`, plus the `qilaidev` studio profile index.

Q: What is `cleanplate`?
A: `cleanplate` (`https://github.com/qilaidev/cleanplate`) is a local-first async AI video watermark detection, ROI inpainting, and visual QA pipeline built on FastAPI, ComfyUI diffusion backends, and FFmpeg. It is qilai's core AI Video Generation & Multimodal pipeline infrastructure.

Q: How do the open-source repositories emphasize privacy and determinism?
A: Core tools avoid mandatory SaaS accounts and telemetry: `PromptPanel` runs on local SQLite FTS5, `totp-authenticator` computes RFC 6238 tokens offline with WebCrypto, `wechat-localmind` and `whatsapp-localmind` read atomic local snapshots with strict group-only isolation, `social-cleaner` enforces `--dry-run` and backups, and `anyreality-resi-stack` passes `scripts/redact.sh` secret hygiene checks.

Q: Where are machine-readable metadata and contact channels?
A: Machine-readable metadata: `./llms.txt`, `./codemeta.json`, `https://qilaidav.com/llms.txt`. Telegram: `@BD8888` (`https://t.me/BD8888`), public channel: `@AIKB8` (`https://t.me/AIKB8`), email: `hello@qilaidav.com`.
